This happens because Git's history on your `deploy/blog` branch still contains the original commit where you added that large file. When you push, GitHub examines all new commits and rejects the one containing the oversized file, even if a later commit removed it.

To resolve this, we need to rewrite the branch's history to completely remove any trace of `links.md`. I'll do this by squashing the commit that added the file and the commit that deleted it into a single, clean commit.
